description: IN-list over a nullable column is nullable -- NULL IN (1, 2) is NULL, not false

columns.name: matched
columns.note: category is nullable, so category IN ('a', 'b') is NULL when category IS NULL

name: in_list_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetCategoryMatches
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, category IN ('a', 'b') AS matched FROM items
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE items (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT)
